accessGaps: Cadastral named areas are reviewed. The cru name also identifies a smaller constituent, so white wines retain the whole-cru INAO outline. No producer holding is inferred.
Source boundaries, failed notice downloads and unsearched intervals are reported in the history coverage; none means no historical record.
Current farming remains unconfirmed for every parcel.
INPI and Pappers each returned HTTP 403 in the first batch attempt. The same shared access gap applies; public registry and actes.ccm2.net records were used.

New Chevalier company screening: 11 distinct filings / 152 pages, all OCR-screened at 150 dpi with RapidOCR and DirectML. Existing shared links, searches and effort were reused and remain unchanged; two cited Latour PDF hashes were reverified and relevant page images compared.

Louis Violland, the municipality, SCI Montille et Partners and GFV Le Chevalier de Puligny-Montrachet have explicit no-link searches. Similar names, individual managers and unnamed SCEA lease clauses do not establish a producer company relationship.
Three exact current-parcel matches are accepted: AH8, AH92 and AH93. Opale AH150/151 are external historical context. Printed Prieur AH3 remains unmatched to AH123 despite equal area.
The GFV formation copy prints 14 May 2011 but references a February 2012 promise and was deposited June 2012; the date conflict remains unresolved and is not used as a land-transfer date.

Bouchard’s HTML holding pages returned HTTP 500; the freely available La Cabotte technical sheet was obtained. The Prieur 2017 technical sheet was reviewed but gives no holding area, so no census figure is inferred from it.

All eight requested Chevalier Winehog articles were supplied as MHTML and reviewed. 11 referenced image occurrences (9 distinct URLs) were not embedded and remain unreviewed. The Leflaive pair repeats one account. Only AH68 and AH126 have matching individual numbers and areas; aggregate holdings and historical numbering remain unmatched.

Supplemental Pappers review on 10 October 2026 adds two distinct PDFs / 37 pages: 13 new PDFs / 189 pages including the original Chevalier pass. Violland has a conflicting-company enclosure; Auvenay is debt conversion without a qualifying land schedule. Existing links, identities and original effort are preserved.

Owner-supplied images (10 October 2026, photos.zip): 8 of the 9 distinct images missing from the Chevalier Winehog archives were supplied and reviewed; file names, SHA-256 hashes and sizes are recorded on each source. One d’Auvenay image (C5F549F8) was not in the archive and remains unreviewed. Images and archives stay outside the repository.
